claim.value: A rise confined to one crew supports a narrower trial.
claim.scope: Conditional on observing a crew-confined rise. The particular rising delay measure and exact trial boundaries are unspecified.

provenance.rationale: The cited span explicitly supplies the crew-specific condition and narrower-trial implication.

signal_basis.value: Repeated comparable measurements show a rise in late-start rates or delay duration confined to one crew when comparable crew and equipment groups are examined.
signal_basis.scope: Assumed observed for this judgment. Comparisons include booking denominators and recording completeness; apparent patterns remain vulnerable to measurement and workload changes. The evidence informs practical trial selection, without establishing causation or statistical proof.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the temporal measures, comparable-group analysis, crew-confined pattern, reporting requirements and inferential limits.
No unresolved empirical bridge is required for this bounded trial-selection claim.

rationale: A rise localized to one crew provides a reason to focus a trial on that affected subgroup. This licenses the stated practical narrowing without identifying the cause, specifying the intervention or establishing that it will succeed.
uncertainty: The rising measure and precise trial boundaries remain unspecified, but neither is necessary to judge this limited directional claim.
